full_page.content:
1947, February 6
The following is a faithful transcription of a photocopy from the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
"O all ye works of the Lord! bless the Lord ..... forever." February 6th, 1947
God bless you Dear Sister Emma Kelsey Casey - you and yours,
I just read your welcome card of the fourth and thank God you are well to write and get along so well. "Yes Msgr. Edw'd and Br. Owen joined us here the night of Jan. 25th. Grace "beat them to it" by plain from San Francisco and sur- prised them on their arrival in the Grand Central Depot - all coming together to the Monastery about 8 o'cl. Saturday 25th P.M. ) Grace phoned from E'd Sampson's and the telegram of her coming arrived Monday a.m. in the mail.
The celebration - Solemn Mass, etc. was quite impressive as seemed to me. Only there not room for one half of the crowd that had come.
I am sending you a few little cards that tell more in a few words that many letters might express. Thanks be to God for the privilege and for every detail and God bless our Guardian Angels - visible and invisible - each and all - for their part in the program -
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Original in possession of Sister Anne Herkenrath 2911 W. Ft. Wright Dr. Spokane, WA. 99203
